name: Market 001 — Cari Hesaplar listesi ve yeni iptal
description: Demo Market (001) Finans → Kartlar → Cari Hesaplar listesi açılır; Yeni açılarak İptal ile kapatılır.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Market (001), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Yönetim
In the Yönetim sidebar, open Finans / Finans Yönetimi then Kartlar
Click the menu item Cari Hesaplar
Click Yeni or equivalent new-account control if visible
Close the form with İptal or the dialog close control without saving
Verify the Cari Hesaplar list screen remains visible with a table, toolbar, or empty-state for current accounts — not a blank error page
